summary: Gamehaus Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a founder/chairman shareholder letter following Nov 2, 2026 definitive agreements to acquire roughly 56% of Techforge Co., Ltd, holding company of AI-native micro-serial platform Anamana Pte. Ltd.; the US-equivalent disclosure is a current report on Form 8-K. No price, premium or break fee is stated. Closing expected November 2026 subject to customary conditions. Post-close, Anamana becomes the primary growth engine while legacy gaming is managed for cash flow; watch regulatory/condition risk and disclosure of consideration terms.
